description: The recurring post office counter: a pigeonhole-rack behind (x 510-1410, y 150-560) and the library posting-counter in front at translate(510 560) (sign plate y 582-678, counter top y 730, postal-red front to y 977), on the cream canvas. The recurring white envelope with its red POSTE RESTANTE postmark rests on the counter or in the centre pigeonhole; a person-icon customer stands at the right.
